freq = 440.0

lead = np.sin(2 * np.pi * freq * t) * 0.5
lead += np.sin(2 * np.pi * freq * 3 * t) * 0.25
lead += np.sin(2 * np.pi * freq * 5 * t) * 0.125
lead *= np.exp(-t * 3)
lead = np.clip(lead, -1.0, 1.0)

# 5. Hi-hat/click - short noise
click_len = 4410
click = np.random.randn(click_len) * 0.2
click *= np.exp(-np.arange(click_len) / sample_rate * 50)
click = np.clip(click, -1.0, 1.0)

import struct

    """Save float32 PCM as WAV"""
    # Convert to int16
